verdict.rationale: The axis applies because Caveman has a cloud API with base-URL connection and published docs. The only related evidence is a probe showing a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at docs.caveman.so/openapi.json. A raw spec file is an adjacent building block, not an interactive API reference, and nothing in the pack documents an explorer, a try-it console, or runnable examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
